Sure, we can totally help you narrow it down.
For all‑day water: Series 3 Bottles (350ml, 500ml, 1L) keep drinks cold 36–60 hours, are 100% leak‑proof, and hand‑wash only.
Super-sized hydration / sharing: Big Mouth Bottles (2L, 4L) keep drinks cold for 72 hours, hot for 48, work with fizzy and alcoholic drinks, and have a sturdy handle.
Coffee and tea on the go: Series 2 Coffee Cups (340ml, 500ml) are insulated, not fully leak‑proof if inverted, and must be kept upright with hot drinks.
Hot + cold, straw or sip: Series 2 Switch Cups (500ml, 750ml) switch between straw and cup mode, work with fizzy drinks, and keep drinks hot or cold for several hours (but don’t use the straw with hot liquids).
Food and picnics: Our Cutlery Set is stainless steel, compact in an aluminum case, dishwasher safe for main utensils, and great for on‑the‑go eating.
Budgeting your purchase (UK, orders over £60): You can use Klarna to Pay in 3 or Pay in 30 days, interest‑free when paid on time.
Think about how you’ll mainly use it: commuting with coffee (Series 2 Coffee Cup), everyday water bottle (Series 3), big adventures or festivals (Big Mouth), mixed drinks and smoothies (Series 2 Switch), or lunches out and about (Cutlery Set).

I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
If you’re trying to keep things budget-friendly with us, here are your best options:
Gift cards: You can buy them in fixed amounts (£10, £25, £50, £100) and they never expire, so you only spend what you’re comfortable with.
Spread payments: On orders over £60, you can use Klarna to either Pay in 3 instalments or Pay in 30 days, both interest-free when paid on time.
Cobranding orders: If you’re looking at branded products, note we have a minimum order of 30 units per size/color (90 for full wrap; higher for bespoke), and UK/EU/Switzerland delivery is already included in the unit cost, which helps with predictability.
Samples: If you need to see a branded sample first, pre-production samples are £60/€60 each, so factor that into your budget.
Payment methods: We support lots of standard cards and wallets (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Apple Pay, Google Pay, etc.), so you can use whichever fits your usual budgeting setup.
If any payment issues pop up or you need to cancel a gift card you’ve bought, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent for more help.
